Please redact private data. No full transcript is required.
請先移除敏感資料，不需要整份對話。未觀察到或不知道的項目可以留空。

## Environment / 使用環境

- Skill version / Skill 版本：
- Agent/IDE and version / 工具與版本：
- Model and effort, if known / 模型與推理設定（知道才填）：
- Programming experience / 程式經驗：

## Goal and stage / 目標與階段

What did you want to make, and where did you stop?
你想做什麼？停在規劃、實作、測試還是交付？

## What helped / 有幫助的地方

## Confusing or incorrect excerpt / 看不懂或錯誤的原句

Include a short redacted excerpt, expected behavior and what actually happened.
請附簡短去識別原句、預期和實際結果；也可以回報多次重問或文書太多。

## Next step and completion / 下一步與完成判斷

Could you tell what to do next and how to check the result? What help was needed?
你是否知道現在做什麼、哪些還沒開始、如何確認完成？需要多少補充說明？

## Time and burden (optional) / 時間與負擔（選填）

Approximate time, repeated questions, corrections or documents you had to manage.
大約耗時、重問次數、需要糾正的地方或額外管理的文件。
